# Tabelog

> > Japan's comprehensive restaurant discovery and reservation platform with 895,000+ dining listings across major cities including Tokyo, Osaka, Kyoto, and Fukuoka.

Tabelog serves as the authoritative restaurant guide for travelers and locals exploring Japanese cuisine and dining experiences. The multilingual platform provides detailed restaurant information, user reviews, ratings, and reservation capabilities for discovering authentic dining across Japan's diverse culinary landscape.

## Key Topics

- Japanese restaurants
- Tokyo dining
- Osaka restaurants
- Kyoto cuisine
- Fukuoka food scene
- Restaurant reservations
- Japan travel dining
- Restaurant reviews and ratings
- Multilingual restaurant guide
- Japanese food culture
- Regional Japanese cuisine
- Dining recommendations

## Main Platform

- [Tabelog - Japan Food & Restaurant Guide for Travelers](https://tabelog.com/en/): Homepage for Japan's restaurant guide with 895K+ listings across Tokyo, Osaka, and other major cities
